description: Classic Breakout on canvas — real ball physics, 5 rows of bricks, 3 lives, score, and speed-up levels.

faqs.a: Mouse, touch-drag, or ←/→ arrow keys. Press Space or tap to launch the ball.
faqs.q: How do I control the paddle?

faqs.a: Bricks are worth 10 points each; clearing the board advances a level and speeds up the ball.
You get 3 lives. Missing the ball costs one; losing all three ends the game.
faqs.q: How many lives do I get?

faqs.a: Yes — the ball speeds up and bricks reset each level.

howto: Move the paddle with mouse, touch, or ←/→.
Launch the ball with Space or a tap.
Break every brick to advance levels.
Don't let the ball past your paddle — 3 lives!
title: Breakout Game
